name: FormBuilderAutocomplete
description: An Autocomplete (free text with suggestions) with its input and list, as UI::FormBuilder renders it.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `FormBuilderAutocomplete(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

FormBuilderChoices.description: A RadioGroup, CheckboxGroup or ChipGroup with one labelled Radio / Checkbox / ChipCheckbox per choice, as UI::FormBuilder renders it. Like Rails' collection helpers, an empty hidden input goes first so a group with nothing chosen still submits its key.

FormBuilderCombobox.description: A Combobox with an input (or chips, when `multiple`) and one item per choice, as UI::FormBuilder renders it.

FormBuilderField.description: A labelled Field around one control, as UI::FormBuilder renders it: the label above the control (`layout: :stacked`), beside it (`:inline`, for a check box or switch) or shown by the control itself (`:control`, a toggle button's text).

FormBuilderOTP.description: An OTPField with one input per character, as UI::FormBuilder renders it. The first input carries the Field's control id so the label focuses it.

FormBuilderSelect.description: A Select with a trigger, value and one item per choice, as UI::FormBuilder renders it.

FormBuilderToggle.description: A Toggle painted as an outline Button, as UI::FormBuilder renders it: the button shows the label, the Field around it the description and error.

FormBuilderToggleGroup.description: A ToggleGroup with one outline Button Toggle per choice, as UI::FormBuilder renders it.

examples.name: Text field
examples.code:
user = demo_user(errors, name: "", email: "ada@", website: "example.com")

phlex do
  form_with(model: user, url: main_app.form_submissions_path, class: "flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-5") do |form|
    form.ui.text_field :name, description: "As it appears on your profile"
    form.ui.email_field :email, placeholder: "ada@example.com"
    form.ui.url_field :website, placeholder: "https://"
    Button(type: "submit", class: "self-start") { "Submit" }
  end
end

examples.name: Nested fields
examples.notes: `fields_for` builders have `ui` too: Rails supplies the `_attributes` names and row indices.
examples.code:
user = demo_user(errors, address: Address.new(city: ""), phones: [ Phone.new(number: "bad", kind: "mobile"), Phone.new(kind: "work") ])

phlex do
  form_with(model: user, url: main_app.form_submissions_path, class: "flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-5") do |form|
    form.fields_for :address do |address|
      address.ui.text_field :city
      address.ui.select :country, Address::COUNTRIES, prompt: "Pick a country"
    end
    form.fields_for :phones do |phone|
      div(class: "grid min-w-0 grid-cols-1 items-start gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_8rem]") do
        phone.ui.telephone_field :number, placeholder: "+420 123 456 789"
        phone.ui.select :kind, Phone::KINDS, label: "Kind"
      end
    end
    Button(type: "submit", class: "self-start") { "Submit" }
  end
end
